title: Card Eater
statementMd:
## Problem Statement

Snuke has decided to play a game using cards. He has a deck consisting of $N$ cards. On the $i$-th card from the top, an integer $A_i$ is written.

He will perform the operation described below zero or more times, so that the values written on the remaining cards will be pairwise distinct. Find the maximum possible number of remaining cards. Here, $N$ is odd, which guarantees that at least one card can be kept.

Operation: Take out three arbitrary cards from the deck. Among those three cards, eat two: one with the largest value, and another with the smallest value. Then, return the remaining one card to the deck.

## Constraints

- $3 ≦ N ≦ 10^{5}$
- $N$ is odd.
- $1 ≦ A_i ≦ 10^{5}$
- $A_i$ is an integer.

## Input

The input is given from Standard Input in the following format:

```
N
A_1 A_2 A_3 ... A_{N}
```

## Output

Print the answer.
statementZhMd:
## 题目描述

Snuke 决定使用卡牌进行游戏。他有一副由 $N$ 张卡牌组成的牌堆。从顶部数第 $i$ 张卡牌上写有一个整数 $A_i$。

他将进行零次或多次如下操作，使剩余卡牌上写的数值两两不同。请找出剩余卡牌数量的最大值。这里，$N$ 为奇数，这保证了至少可以保留一张卡牌。

操作：从牌堆中任意取出三张卡牌。在这三张卡牌中吃掉两张：一张是数值最大的一张，另一张是数值最小的一张。然后将剩下的一张卡牌放回牌堆。

## 约束条件

- $3 ≦ N ≦ 10^{5}$
- $N$ 为奇数。
- $1 ≦ A_i ≦ 10^{5}$
- $A_i$ 为整数。

## 输入格式

输入从标准输入按以下格式给出：

```
N
A_1 A_2 A_3 ... A_{N}
```

## 输出格式

输出答案。

samples.note: One optimal solution is to perform the operation once, taking out two cards with $1$ and one card with $2$. One card with $1$ and another with $2$ will be eaten, and the remaining card with $1$ will be returned to deck. Then, the values written on the remaining cards in the deck will be pairwise distinct: $1$, $3$ and $7$.
